_README.what: The 10 E-Kat feats from Sieg's Guide, with machine-readable effects. Authority is oks/pathfinder/house-rules/luck.md; the rule text itself is the Luck Google Doc.
_README.why_curated: data/feats_new.csv rows 3278-3287 carry these feats but NO runtime module opens that file, and its effects are prose only ('Gain 4 E-Kats per session ... and a +4 Luck'). phase_luck_resolution has to compute a feedback loop from these numbers, which prose cannot supply. Ten rows is small enough to hand-curate; see docs/CODEBASE_MAP.md.
_README.csv_defects_recorded: Two prerequisite chains are unsatisfiable AS DATA in feats_new.csv and are corrected here, not there: 'It Just Works' reads prerequisite 'Asspull' (glued, never matches 'Ass pull'), and 'Luck God' reads 'All of the above' (a summarising phrase, not a feat name). compile_feats_new.py REGENERATES feats_new.csv, so patching the CSV would be overwritten -- this file is authoritative for the runtime.
_README.generic_luck_rule: Every positive luck-based feat grants +1 Luck, EXCEPT those stating a larger explicit bonus (Ass Pull, It Just Works, Luck God at +4 each) which do not additionally collect the +1. grants_generic_luck encodes that; validate_luck.py asserts luck_bonus and grants_generic_luck are never both set.

effect_fields.luck_bonus: explicit permanent Luck granted by this feat (0 means it takes the generic +1 instead)
effect_fields.grants_generic_luck: whether the generic +1 Luck per positive luck feat applies
effect_fields.doubles_acquisition: Double Down -- doubles permanent E-Kat acquisition, feeding luck.e_kat_reserve()
effect_fields.halves_e_kat_costs: Luck God -- in-play spend discount, carried for the sheets, not applied at generation
effect_fields.e_kats_per_long_rest: permanent E-Kats gained per in-game long rest
effect_fields.temporary_e_kats_per_session: E-Kats that expire at session end (do not enter the starting reserve)
effect_fields.hero_points_per_session: temporary hero points granted per session (It Just Works)
effect_fields.roll_bonus_multiplier: multiplier on roll-based E-Kat bonuses (Lucky Boy 2, Very Lucky Boy 3)

Stream of Luck.benefit: Gain one E-Kat per session (character played), two if you have Double Down.

Sweet Dreams.benefit: Gain one E-Kat per in-game long rest, two if you have Double Down. (Applies once to timeskips longer than a day.)

Very Lucky Boy.benefit: E-Kat (roll based) bonuses are increased to triple.

Ass Pull.benefit: Gain 4 E-Kats per session that expire upon the session's end, and a +4 Luck.

It Just Works.csv_prerequisite_defect: feats_new.csv reads 'Asspull' -- glued, never matches 'Ass pull'. Unsatisfiable as data; corrected here.
It Just Works.benefit: Gain one free Hero Point per session that expires upon the session's end, +4 Luck.

Middle Finger.benefit: Gain 1 E-Kat anytime the GM has a hostile NPC utilize a Hero Point.

Right of Deferment.benefit: You may wait to apply E-Kats after a roll for no penalty.

Luck God.csv_prerequisite_defect: feats_new.csv reads 'All of the above' -- a summarising phrase, not a feat name, which the string prereq engine can never resolve. Expanded here to the nine feats it summarises.
Luck God.benefit: All E-Kat costs (excluding the 99 tier and purchasing new Luck Traits) are cut in half; you gain a +2 bonus to all saves, attacks, ability checks, skill checks, AC, and Caster Level Checks. You gain a +4 Luck, and once per day can force a reroll in your favor.
